implementation.targetScope: Cached filesystem paths, directory traversal and streaming for VentiMath glob callers; POSIX, Darwin and Windows resolution.

differences: Independent iterative traversal with VPM LRU and stream dependencies.
chdir clears resolved-string caches instead of returning paths under the previous directory.
Wide directory enumeration avoids argument-stack-sized spread calls.
Internal base-class construction/private state are not compatibility contracts. No bundled glob replacement or application adoption claimed.

upstreamTests.reason: These groups mock upstream module imports; focused public-API tests cover the corresponding behaviors.
